author: Donna Vissman
title: STRYPER to Host Exclusive Album Preview Event in Nashville - NewsBreak
text:
By Donna Vissman ,
8 hours ago photo courtesy of Stryper Christian rock band STRYPER will host an exclusive album preview event on Wednesday, August 26, at the Museum of Christian & Gospel Music in downtown Nashville. Click for More Events
Limited to 70 guests, the one-night-only event will give fans the first opportunity to hear the band’s upcoming album, Throne of Thorns, in its entirety. The album is scheduled for worldwide release Sept. 25 through Frontiers Music Srl.
The event will take place from 5 to 9 p.m. and will include a track-by-track listening session featuring commentary from STRYPER frontman Michael Sweet. Sweet will share stories about the inspiration and creative process behind each song. Purchase tickets here .
Guests will also attend an advance screening of the band’s new music video before its public release.
The evening will include a meet-and-greet, photo opportunity and autograph session with the band, along with dinner, dessert and nonalcoholic beverages from Lady Bird Taco Bar. A special STRYPER pop-up exhibit will showcase rare memorabilia and original artifacts spanning the band’s four-decade career.
“These items come from an extraordinary collection assembled over the past 40 years, with treasures carefully sourced from around the world,” said Brett Christensen, STRYPER’s official historian in a release. “Now, we’ve gathered the very best of that collection—the true cream of the crop—to celebrate the greatest rock band ever to boldly proclaim the name of Jesus.”
Each ticket includes admission to the Museum of Christian & Gospel Music, a commemorative gift, a collectible event laminate and lanyard, and access to purchase Throne of Thorns merchandise, including a limited-edition event poster.
Recording devices will not be permitted during the album-listening session or music video presentation to protect the unreleased material.
“This isn’t simply a listening party,” organizers said. “It’s an opportunity for fans to experience the new record exactly as the band intends it to be heard, hear the stories behind every song, spend meaningful time with the band and celebrate STRYPER’s incredible legacy in one unforgettable evening.”
